reviewer: Same unblinded Codex source/editorial reviewer; not independent or native-speaker certification

checks.scope: All source translations, contexts, unit meanings/chunks, points, source citations, invented examples and available written readings
checks.result: The source and example maintain the explicit singular asking actor and plural recipients. The invented office example supplies third-party supplier context, so its third-party translation is supported. A separate temporal rule is overgeneralized, and the actual source translation narrows an unresolved sender role.

targets.reason: voy a pedir que nos envíen is translated 我今天會請他們把報價單寄給我們; I remains the asking actor and we remain recipients. This targeted observation does not override the case-level grammar rejection.

issues.quote: 子句動詞必須使用虛擬式現在時
issues.description: The rule covers any future, not-yet-realized cuando event and mandates present subjunctive without restricting itself to this simple-tense example. Future temporal clauses also take perfect subjunctive when completion before a later event matters. The RAE entry gives a future main clause followed by cuando hayan comenzado. Tenga is correct in the source; the generalized mandatory tense claim is not. A B1 simplification is a possible pedagogical motive, but this wording does not state that limit, so the same predeclared grammar-scope criterion rejects it.

references.title: RAE-ASALE: pretérito perfecto compuesto de subjuntivo
references.supports: A future prospective use includes a cuando clause with hayan comenzado, contradicting a universal present-subjunctive-only requirement. Severity remains editorial judgment.

issues.quote: 我會請他們把時間表寄給我們。
issues.description: Envíen can correspond to ellos/ellas or formal plural ustedes; no source speaker labels identify the subordinate sender. 他們 selects a third party. That may be a natural generic rendering, and the point itself lists both possibilities, so this is not called a definite actor error. An independent editor should decide whether the source-fidelity criterion instead requires neutral 對方 here.

references.title: RAE-ASALE: conjugación española
references.supports: The conjugation tables distinguish discourse person and show shared plural ustedes/ellos forms. They establish ambiguity, not the right translation or severity.
